LanguageData.TuskCat.label: tusk cat
LanguageData.TuskCat.description: The tusk cat were large feline predators from the worlds of Naboo and its moon Rori. Tusk cats had a large pair of distinct tusks growing from their lower jaws. This put them at morphological odds with many tusked animals which often featured tusks growing from the upper jaw. A second, less-noticeable pair of tusk-like fleshy appendages grew from their cheekbones. Despite their predatory nature, tusk cats could be tamed by humans of Naboo for a variety of uses, notably as mounts which resulted in their spread to various worlds as part of the pack animal trade.

LanguageData.Urusai.label: urusai
LanguageData.Urusai.description: Urusai were winged reptavians native to the desert planet Tatooine. They were predominantly opportunistic scavengers of carrion that would use the thermal currents of their homeworld to travel far and wide in search of an easy meal. Their tolerance to harsh climates and propensity to be clean, efficive corpse disposal meant they were spread to numerous worlds by various corporate and criminal organisations.

LanguageData.Uvak.label: uvak
LanguageData.Uvak.description: Uvak were a large, membranous-winged reptavian species with sharp beaks. They were native to the planet of Kesh, where they were used by the indigenous Keshiri as pack animals and mounts. It's was believed that the deities known as the "Skyborn" may have transplanted these creatures to other worlds before disappearing into Keshiri mythology.

LanguageData.Vapaad.label: vapaad
LanguageData.Vapaad.description: The vapaad, was a large predatory creature native to the world of Sarapin and its moons. Vaapads were brown ball-shaped, tripod creatures with two yellow eyes and multiple tentacles used to kill prey. A vaapad attacked by striking its prey with its toxic tentacles so quickly that they were nothing but a blur to the naked eye. They were exported offworld for use in exotic gladiatorial arenas.

LanguageData.Varactyl.label: varactyl
LanguageData.Varactyl.description: Varactyls, also known as 'dragonmounts', were reptavian herbivores native to the planet Utapau, though some specimens found their way to other worlds (such as Kashyyyk and Belsavis) as their eggs were easily transported by Black-marketeers. They had beaked faces and long, powerful tails and not only could a varactyl run very fast, but their feet were adapted with tiny hairlike structures that allowed them to climb the rocky walls of sinkholes.

LanguageData.Veermok.label: veermok
LanguageData.Veermok.description: Veermoks were a ferocious species of clawed and fanged primates native to the planet Naboo (but with sizeable populations on both Eriadau and Xirl). Living in swamps and moist woodlands, veermoks were arboreal creatures. They were also solitary and aggressive creatures, spending the majority of their lives without others of their kind. Their popularity amongst big game hunters meant they were exported and established on multiple worlds in the Mid and Outer Rim.

LanguageData.Voorpak.label: voorpak
LanguageData.Voorpak.description: Voorpaks were a non-sentient but still quite smart species of puffy-looking mammalians that were native to the planet of Naboo. Diminutive carnivores, voorpaks were much beloved by many due to their cuteness and as pets which in turn led to their export to many other worlds.

LanguageData.Vornskyr.label: vornskyr
LanguageData.Vornskyr.description: The vornskr were a pack hunting canine beast native to the forest planet Myrkr. Vornskrs were primarily nocturnal hunters, and used their whip-like, mildly venomous tails to stun prey before finishing it off with their teeth. They were popular attack beasts and pets within several criminal organisations and thus they were spread to numerous worlds as a result.

LanguageData.Warbird.label: Warbird
LanguageData.Warbird.description: The Warbird (or 'Sith warbird') was a species of huge flightless avian from the frigid planet Khar Delba. Sith warbirds were notorious for their bad temper and they typically used their large size to ram down their prey and gore them with their serrated beaks. After the end of the Great Sith War, Sith warbirds continued to be found throughout the galaxy, with survivors of the conflict breeding on worlds where battles had been fought by the Sith. These wild-once-more warbirds were prone to terrorizing local forms of wildlife that posed little threat to them.

LanguageData.WarWyrm.label: war wyrm
LanguageData.WarWyrm.description: The war wyrm (or sometimes called the 'sith wyrm') were a truly colossal creature believed to have been created on the fourth moon of Yavin where one such creature lived in a large subterranean lair beneath a Massassi temple. The war wyrm was originally an infant exogorth that had been mutated and warped by Sith alchemy. They were very rare and very large and several specimens were believed to have been left behind by Sith armies on various worlds having fulfilled their roles as apex siege beasts.

LanguageData.Whisperbird.label: whisperbird
LanguageData.Whisperbird.description: Whisper birds were energetic avians native to the moon Yavin 4. They were known for their radiant plumage and gained their name due to their seemingly noiseless flight. They used their dexterous tongue to emit their sweet, low-pitched song or call. These traits made them popular pets with avian enthausiasts and wild populations soon appeared from escapees on numerous worlds (even on polluted worlds like Coruscant).

LanguageData.Worrt.label: worrt
LanguageData.Worrt.description: The Worrt was an amphibious creature native to the planet Tatooine, though they could also be found on other worlds (including Nal Hutta and Phaeda). Worrts were omnivorous, but was also known to attempt to eat rocks and metal objects. They used their long, prehensile tongue to catch smaller prey, such as gorgs, but were known to also attack creatures larger than itself.

LanguageData.Yobshrimp.label: yobshrimp
LanguageData.Yobshrimp.description: Yobshrimp were a carnivorous crustacean native to the shallow waters of the planet Naboo. These clawed creatures were typically preyed upon by animals such as Blarths and larger scalefish. Some considered this animal a delicacy and many fishing families cultivated the yobshrimp for consumption which resulted in it's dispersal to various worlds.

LanguageData.Zakkeg.label: zakkeg
LanguageData.Zakkeg.description: Zakkegs were rare alpha-predators indigenous to the moon of Dxun. They were huge, armoured quadrupeds, typically solitary and territorial. Even Mandalorians were impressed by someone who killed one, and one could gain great honor for proving one's success. Due to this, several Mandalorian clans and big game hunters exported these creatures to numerous worlds to provide a ready supply of the beasts.
